headNodes.40f27aa6a39507a6c2fab995:
<script type="application/ld+json">
  {
    "@context": "https://schema.org",
    "@graph": [
      {
        "@type": "WebApplication",
        "name": "Cache Cruncher",
        "url": "https://cachecruncher.com/",
        "applicationCategory": "EducationalApplication",
        "operatingSystem": "Any (web browser)",
        "browserRequirements": "Requires JavaScript",
        "description": "Interactive Cache Simulator and Memory Simulator for cache configuration, memory addressing, virtual memory pages, page tables, TLB bits, and visual address mapping.",
        "offers": { "@type": "Offer", "price": "0", "priceCurrency": "USD" },
        "isAccessibleForFree": true,
        "audience": { "@type": "EducationalAudience", "educationalRole": "student" },
        "featureList": [
          "Cache Simulator with visual cache table",
          "Memory Simulator with address-to-block mapping",
          "Index, tag, and offset bit derivation",
          "Direct-mapped and set-associative cache math",
          "Virtual and physical page calculator",
          "Page table size estimator",
          "TLB tag and index bits",
          "Bidirectional auto-fill — type either side of an equation"
        ]
      },
      {
        "@type": "FAQPage",
        "mainEntity": [
          {
            "@type": "Question",
            "name": "How do you calculate cache index bits?",
            "acceptedAnswer": {
              "@type": "Answer",
              "text": "Index bits = log2(number of sets). Number of sets = cache size / (block size × associativity). Cache Cruncher computes this automatically as you type."
            }
          },
          {
            "@type": "Question",
            "name": "How do you calculate cache tag bits?",
            "acceptedAnswer": {
              "@type": "Answer",
              "text": "Tag bits = address size − (index bits + offset bits), where offset bits = log2(block size in bytes)."
            }
          },
          {
            "@type": "Question",
            "name": "How do you calculate TLB tag bits?",
            "acceptedAnswer": {
              "@type": "Answer",
              "text": "TLB tag bits = virtual page number bits − log2(TLB rows). VPN bits = virtual address size − page offset bits."
            }
          },
          {
            "@type": "Question",
            "name": "Is Cache Cruncher free?",
            "acceptedAnswer": {
              "@type": "Answer",
              "text": "Yes. Cache Cruncher is a free, open-source web app that runs entirely in your browser. No account, no tracking, no server-side calculation."
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
  </script>
